ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, point A is the common vertex above, on the left is the original triangle ABC, and on the right is the rotated triangle ADE; it can be seen that the rays AB and AD starting from A respectively connect to the corresponding points B and D. Reasoning: The problem states that triangle ABC is rotated about point A to triangle ADE. According to the naming order of the triangles, the correspondence is A→A, B→D, C→E. The angle of rotation is the angle formed at the rotation center A, from the ray AB of the original point B to the ray AD of its image point D, so the rotation amount of the angle is ∠BAD; it can also be expressed using the corresponding points C→E as ∠CAE.

The angle of rotation is the angle at the center of rotation between the ray from A to the original point and the ray from A to its image, so the rotation angle is ∠BAD.
